_comment: Single source of truth for embed-llamacpp integration test models. Consumed by test/integration/utils.js (ensureModel) for URL resolution + sha256 integrity, and by .github/actions/cache-models for the cache key. Populate sha256/bytes with `node ../diffusion-cpp/scripts/generate-model-manifest.mjs`-style tooling (or fill from a fresh clean download of each pinned URL). While a value is null, ensureModel logs a warning and skips verification for that entry. Bump cacheEpoch to force a hard cache eviction.
